clue.text: Primarily I then refined gold?

indicators.note: refining something reworks it into a purer form, so the preceding letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, ready to be rearranged
a gold medal is awarded for coming first

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether someone has just purified some gold.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram covers only 'I then', which becomes IN THE; gold stands whole for FIRST PLACE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are adverbial phrases meaning firstly or chiefly, used to introduce the main reason.

clue.text: Part of film maybe naturally attached to rock?

parts.note: something incidental to an event follows naturally from it or accompanies it
rock is a kind of music

explanation.surface: A puzzled query about something in a film that is fixed by nature to a boulder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' reads as stone in the surface, but it is the musical genre standing for music in general.
explanation.definitionFit: Incidental music is the background score accompanying a film or play, so it is one component of a movie.

clue.text: Cut a disk from good sea cucumber

parts.note: to trepan is to bore a round piece out of the skull
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: Instructions for slicing a round piece out of a decent sea cucumber.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepang is another name for the sea cucumber, especially as dried and eaten in Asian cooking.

clue.text: Determinedly advanced to capture hideout

indicators.note: capturing something means holding it inside, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: advanced as in ahead of time, premature
a nest is a hideaway or den, as in a nest of thieves

explanation.surface: Someone moved forward resolutely to seize a criminal den.
explanation.definitionFit: To act earnestly is to act seriously and with resolve, a close synonym of determined action.

clue.text: Discover American fellow leaving for river

indicators.note: someone leaving goes away, so that letter is taken out of the combined word

parts.note: to discover is to find
US for the United States
F is the abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS

explanation.surface: Someone learns that an American man has departed, heading for a river.
explanation.walkthrough: FIND plus US makes FINDUS; removing the fellow's F leaves the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indus is a major river of South Asia, flowing through Pakistan to the Arabian Sea.

clue.text: Delays impressions describing product differentiator

indicators.note: to describe can mean to trace a line around, so one word encircles the other

parts.note: impressions or feelings
a USP, unique selling point, is what marks a product out from rivals

explanation.surface: Marketing jargon: launch hold-ups and impressions shaped by what sets a product apart.
explanation.walkthrough: USP, the unique selling point, is marketing jargon for whatever makes a product different.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspense in its older sense is a deferral or postponement, so suspenses are delays.

clue.text: More important pair replacing director in fashion house

indicators.note: replacing means taking another's place, so one letter is swapped out for two

parts.note: Christian Dior is a Paris fashion house
PR is the abbreviation for pair
D is the abbreviation for director

explanation.surface: Two people take over from the creative director at a couture label.
explanation.walkthrough: In DIOR, PR takes the place of the D.
explanation.definitionFit: A prior claim takes precedence over others, so prior means having greater importance or coming first.

clue.text: Church of England fires Catholic of German descent

indicators.note: firing someone dismisses them, so that letter is thrown out

parts.note: the Church of England is the Anglican church
C is the abbreviation for Catholic

explanation.surface: The established church dismisses a Catholic employee with German ancestry.
explanation.definitionFit: The Angles were a Germanic tribe from northern Germany who settled England, so Anglian people descend from them.

clue.text: The Spanish supply economic entry for Bitcoins?

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: read as the adverb of supple, flexibly, so the following words bend into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, ready to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Spain provides an economic way into cryptocurrency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supply' looks like a verb meaning provide, but it is supple turned adverb, and signals the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitcoin is a digital currency, one example of money held and exchanged electronically; the question mark marks the example.

clue.text: Brought in and acquitted

definitions.meaning: first meaning: earned as net profit

explanation.surface: A suspect was taken into custody and then found not guilty.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both making a net profit and being found innocent in court, two separate senses of one word.

clue.text: Stones record about heroin

indicators.note: about means around, so the first word wraps the second

parts.note: a single is a record with one main track
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A Rolling Stones release about drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stones' with its capital suggests the Rolling Stones; here it means pebbles.
explanation.definitionFit: Shingle is a mass of small rounded pebbles, as found on many beaches.

clue.text: Globetrotting hero rejected some of the Kardashians

indicators.note: rejected suggests being sent back, so the letters are read from right to left
some of means only a part, so the letters sit inside the following words

parts.note: the end of the and the start of Kardashians

explanation.surface: A travelling celebrity was turned down by members of a famous reality-TV family.
explanation.walkthrough: Read backwards across 'thE KARDashians'. Sir Francis Drake was the first Englishman to sail round the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Drake circumnavigated the globe in the 1570s and became a national hero in Elizabethan England.

clue.text: Paid to bottle prime bit of Indian flavouring

indicators.note: bottling something holds it inside, so one word encloses the others

parts.note: money paid out is money spent
to prime a weapon or device is to arm it

indicators.note: a bit is a small piece, here just the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: the opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone paid to preserve a choice piece of Indian food seasoning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prime' looks like an adjective, choice, but it is the verb meaning to make ready to fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Spearmint is a mint whose oil is widely used to flavour gum, toothpaste and sweets.

clue.text: Those who delay retirement reportedly champion members of Parliament?

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said, so the sound of the word matters, not its spelling

parts.note: a knight is a champion who fights on another's behalf
a parliament is the collective noun for a group of owls

explanation.surface: Political: those who postpone stepping down, apparently backing MPs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retirement' suggests leaving a job; it means going to bed. Members of Parliament look like MPs, but a group of owls is called a parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: Night owls are people who habitually stay up late, putting off going to bed.

clue.text: Petty officer involved in battle losing final game

indicators.note: to be involved in something is to be inside it, so one piece sits within the other
losing its final letter means the word is cut short by one at the end

parts.note: the Battle of Waterloo, 1815
PO is the abbreviation for petty officer

explanation.surface: A naval NCO took part in a battle that ended in defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Losing final' reads as a defeat in a cup final, but it simply strips the last letter of the battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Water polo is a team sport played in a swimming pool, so it is a game.

clue.text: Relish old dance

parts.note: relish as in a sharp flavour
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys a traditional dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relish' reads as a verb, to enjoy; here it is the noun for a strong taste.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is a ballroom dance that originated in Buenos Aires.

clue.text: Excellent rhubarb dish served up in restaurant

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means the letters run from bottom to top, the wrong way round

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the 1 written as the letter I
rhubarb is British slang for nonsense
a tart is a pastry dish

explanation.surface: A first-class rhubarb pudding is brought to the table at an eatery.
explanation.walkthrough: Rhubarb looks like the dessert ingredient, but in British usage it also means nonsense or rot.
explanation.definitionFit: A trattoria is an informal Italian eating place, a kind of restaurant.

clue.text: One has to shout about bowling lane

parts.note: a, the indefinite article, means one

indicators.note: about can mean turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to shout is to yell

explanation.surface: Someone must yell about the lane at the bowling alley.
explanation.definitionFit: An alley is the long narrow lane down which skittles or bowling balls are rolled.

clue.text: See type of green car

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a bishop's diocese, here a cathedral city in eastern England
second meaning: a bright green cloth of the kind worn by Robin Hood
third meaning: an American luxury car brand made by Ford

explanation.surface: Look at this green model of car.
explanation.walkthrough: A triple definition. A see is a bishop's diocese; Lincoln green is the colour of Robin Hood's outlaws.
explanation.definitionFit: The one name covers an English cathedral city and diocese, a traditional shade of green cloth, and a Ford-owned car marque.

clue.text: Italian over for university in Italy sees conductor

indicators.note: for here means in place of, so one letter stands where another was

parts.note: a Tuscan is a person from Tuscany in Italy
O is the cricket abbreviation for over
U is the abbreviation for university
taken as written
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: An Italian who has finished university in Italy goes to see a maestro.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' is the cricket term, abbreviated O on scorecards, and 'for' means instead of; I is Italy's international car code.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a celebrated Italian orchestral conductor of the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Middle-eastern airlines flying without navigator at first

indicators.note: something flying is moving about, so the letters are thrown into a new order
without means lacking, so that letter is removed

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: the opening letter

explanation.surface: Carriers from the Middle East operating flights without a navigator on board at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel is a Middle Eastern country, so anything from it is Middle-eastern.

clue.text: Well kept islands preserved

parts.note: the Isle of Man plus I, the abbreviation for island
meat or fish preserved by salting is cured

explanation.surface: Some well-maintained islands have been conserved.
explanation.definitionFit: Manicured describes something neatly trimmed and tended, like a lawn or garden, so carefully maintained.

clue.text: Better leading lady for play

parts.note: to cap a story is to better or top it
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen, is the realm's leading lady

explanation.surface: Theatre: an improved star actress is wanted for a production.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Play' suggests a drama to go with the leading lady; it means frolic.
explanation.definitionFit: To caper is to skip or frolic playfully, so play in the sense of romping about.

clue.text: Young girl and judge regularly put things right

parts.note: a deb, debutante, is a young woman entering society

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: the second and fourth letters

explanation.surface: A girl and a magistrate routinely sort matters out.
explanation.definitionFit: To debug is to find and remove faults from a program or system, which fixes what is wrong.

clue.text: Buzz coming from almost all of the game before noon

indicators.note: almost all means everything but a little, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: taken as written
RU is rugby union
M stands for meridian, noon, as in a.m. and p.m.

explanation.surface: Excitement generated by nearly the whole of a morning match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Buzz' reads as excitement but means a low humming sound; RU, rugby union, is a standard crossword game.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrum is a continuous low humming or drumming noise, close in sense to a buzz.

clue.text: Timeless porticos redesigned for house

indicators.note: a redesign changes the layout, so the remaining letters are rearranged
less means without, so the abbreviation for time is taken out

parts.note: taken as written; T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Classical columned porches are reworked to suit a new home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'House' looks like a building to go with porticos; it is an astrological house, a sign of the zodiac.
explanation.definitionFit: In astrology, each zodiac sign is called a house, and Scorpio is the eighth sign.

clue.text: Rudely interrupt deal when bridge player replaces second ace

indicators.note: replaces means takes the place of, so one letter is swapped for another

parts.note: a deal, an agreement
East is one of the four players at bridge
A is ace in card notation; the second one in the word is meant

explanation.surface: A card player cuts in on a deal by swapping out an ace.
explanation.walkthrough: In BARGAIN the second A becomes E, the East player at bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: To barge in is to burst into a room or conversation without invitation, interrupting rudely.

clue.text: This may move up if recovering fatty exercises!

indicators.note: exercising works and moves the body about, so the letters are put through a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, ready to be rearranged

explanation.surface: If an overweight person in recovery works out, something about their body shifts upward.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also reads as physics: a slimmer, fitter body may carry its balance point higher.
explanation.definitionFit: A body's centre of gravity is the point where its weight acts, and it rises when weight is lost from below.
